title: The board /rankings renders is not the board GET /api/data serves: the stock frontend body {"tep_multiplier":1.15} changes 627 of 740 ranks and 654 tiers while the response stamps isCustomized:false
claimUnderTest: CLAUDE.md: 'Custom source configurations flow through the SAME canonical pipeline as the default board'; the delta is described as 'only the override-sensitive fields' merged onto the cached base, and rankingsOverride.isCustomized reports whether the board was customised.
observed: A live browser load of http://127.0.0.1:3000/rankings POSTs {"tep_multiplier":1.15} (the /settings default) to /api/rankings/overrides?view=delta. That response is a materially different board from GET /api/data: 627 of 740 canonicalConsensusRank values differ, 654 canonicalTierId values differ, 135 rankDerivedValue values differ (82 TE, 50 PICK, 3 other) — yet rankingsOverride.isCustomized is false and no field on the response says the board diverged. Cause: an explicit tep_multiplier bypasses the measured base->tepp TE basis curve (ADR-015, 1.209 at the top rising toward 2.05 down the board) and substitutes a flat 1.15 — the exact constant ADR-015 removed for sitting below the entire observed range. Deep TEs lose up to 21% of value and ~200 ranks. The server-side engines (trade suggestions, finder, angles, terminal, simulate) all read latest_contract_data, i.e. the GET /api/data board — so the page and the advice disagree by construction.

reproduction.command: curl -s -b /tmp/audit-cookies.txt -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/rankings/overrides?view=delta' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tep_multiplier":1.15}' -o /tmp/tep.json; .venv/bin/python docs/master-site-audit/evidence/W03/delta_rt.py  # and see tep-board-divergence.json
reproduction.expected: delta ranks/tiers/values identical to GET /api/data when isCustomized is false, or isCustomized:true plus a stated reason
reproduction.actual: 627 rank / 654 tier / 135 value divergences with isCustomized:false

numericProof.formula: pageValue = blended_TE_value_on_base_basis * flat_tep_multiplier  (explicit slider bypasses convert_te_value base->tepp)

userImpact: A manager reads Tyler Conklin at #666 / 1,142 on /rankings, then opens /trade where the engine values him at 1,450 (#469) — a 21% price difference on the same asset, in the same session, with no label distinguishing the two boards. Every TE trade priced from the rankings page is priced off a board no engine uses.

priorFinding.note: A12-F05 identified that a TEP-only body reaches the pipeline as source_overrides=={} (which is how it clears the 'not source_overrides' guard); it framed the consequence as a snapshot write. The board divergence itself and the isCustomized:false mislabel are new.

whatWorks: The delta payload is internally consistent with its own view=full sibling — zero field mismatches across all 1,092 rows and all 43 _DELTA_PLAYER_FIELDS (W03-F002).
rootCause: normalize_tep_multiplier extracts tep_multiplier as a reserved top-level knob that normalize_source_overrides deliberately skips, so the body produces source_overrides == {} and rankingsOverride.isCustomized == False, while tep_multiplier is still threaded into build_rankings_delta_payload and does change the board. 'Customised' is defined as 'has source overrides' rather than 'differs from the canonical board'.
requiredRepair: Either (a) build the canonical GET /api/data contract with the same default tep_multiplier the frontend posts so the two boards are one board, or (b) stamp isCustomized:true (or a distinct boardVariant/tepMultiplier field) on any response whose tep_multiplier differs from the contract's, and thread the same multiplier into the engine paths. Separately, decide whether the /settings default should be the flat 1.15 that ADR-015 retired.
dependencies: Interacts with the value-pipeline workstream (ADR-015 TE basis) and the trade-engine workstream (engine board selection).
